title: Velké trápení
writer: Jirí Hanibal, Helena Smahelová, Otto Zelenka
actors: Renata Masková, Jana Stepánková, Bozena Böhmová
plot: After the separation of her parents from her father, a 13-year-old girl is placed in an orphanage where she has difficulty settling in, but then begins to break away from her father because she sees through his selfishness.
